en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 478 - It is narrated from Qarqara from Ismail bin Abdullah bin Maimoon from Muhammad bin Abdur Rahman from Ja’far bin Saad Kahili from Amash from Bashir bin Ghalib that he said:
“Sufyani will come from the Roman area in the disguise of a Christian, wearing a cross and leading a group.”
